intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both teach {{course}} in {{cityA}}, and both appear in the NIRF Architecture lists we hold. This page compares recorded fees, placements and ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.

CEPT University vs Nirma University for architecture is a same-city choice. CEPT has the higher Architecture rank in our records, from NIRF 2024 at 6. Nirma has the newer 2025 Architecture rank, at 29.

sections.heading: CEPT University vs Nirma University for B.Arch: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose CEPT University if the older but higher Architecture rank matters most. CEPT is ranked 6 in NIRF 2024 Architecture in our records. We do not have a 2025 Architecture rank for CEPT on this page.
Choose Nirma University if you want the 2025 Architecture rank, at 29, and the higher recorded 2023 figures, at an average of ₹9 lakh and a highest of ₹15 lakh.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: CEPT University has recorded B.Arch tuition of ₹2.75 lakh a year, plus an other charge of ₹25,000. Treat the tuition as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed five-year total, until you check CEPT's current official circular. Official programme pages we opened did not publish a clear 2026 fee table.

Nirma University has recorded B.Arch tuition of ₹2.30 lakh a year. That is lower than CEPT's recorded year tuition. Confirm Nirma's current Institute of Architecture fee notice, because university fees change by admission year.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 year, so the figures can be read together more fairly than on many other comparisons.

Nirma's 2023 figures are an average package of ₹9 lakh and a highest package of ₹15 lakh. CEPT's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both universities list NATA on this page. A valid NATA score and Class 12 or equivalent with the required marks remain the usual route into a five-year B.Arch programme.
Read the current Council of Architecture and university admissions notices for eligibility, tests and counselling or institute-level selection.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. CEPT is a specialist university for architecture, planning and design in the city. Nirma's Institute of Architecture and Planning is on the university's Sarkhej-Gandhinagar highway campus.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, visit both studios and workshops. The city is the same; the campus culture is not.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the higher Architecture rank we hold, CEPT at NIRF 2024 rank 6 is the stronger listed name, even though that rank is a year older than Nirma's 2025 rank of 29.
If you want the higher recorded 2023 packages and a 2025 Architecture rank, Nirma University is the clearer side on this page, with a lower recorded year tuition of ₹2.30 lakh.
Confirm both official fee notices before you budget. CEPT's recorded ₹2.75 lakh is a year fee, not a proven five-year total.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, CEPT University or Nirma University, for B.Arch?
faqs.answer: CEPT has the higher Architecture rank in our records, at NIRF 2024 rank 6. Nirma has the 2025 Architecture rank of 29 and higher recorded 2023 figures, at a ₹9 lakh average and a ₹15 lakh highest package.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Arch fees for CEPT vs Nirma University?
faqs.answer: Our records list CEPT tuition of ₹2.75 lakh a year, plus an other charge of ₹25,000, and Nirma tuition of ₹2.30 lakh a year. These are year figures, not confirmed five-year totals. Confirm both official circulars.

faqs.question: Do both universities accept NATA?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both list NATA on this page. Check the current Council of Architecture and university notices for eligibility and selection.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for CEPT and Nirma architecture?
faqs.answer: Both have recorded 2023 figures. Nirma shows an average of ₹9 lakh and a highest of ₹15 lakh. CEPT shows an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh. These are historical figures, not a guarantee.

faqs.question: Are CEPT and Nirma University in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different campuses. CEPT is a specialist design and architecture campus. Nirma's architecture school is on the university campus on the SG Highway.
